newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CSFB maintains 'buy' rating on Egis.
newsitem.headline: CSFB maintains 'buy' rating on Egis.

text.p: CS First Boston (CSFB) said on Monday it maintained a 'buy' rating on the shares in Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Egis Gyogyszergyar Rt after the company reported its 1996 results.

"The results and the company's partial forecast for 1997 reinforce our view on future earnings development, therefore we have chosen to leave our forecasts unchanged," Spencer Jakab, CSFB's Budapest-based analyst said in a research note.
Jakab said Egis' 1996 HAS (Hungarian Accounting Standards) results were slightly better than CSFB's forecasts.

Egis reported HAS revenues for 1996 of 24.68 billion forints, "almost exactly in line with our forecast," Jakab said. Egis' net income of 5.58 billion for the year was 2.2 percent above CSFB's forecast, he said.
"The stock is our clear favourite over Richter at the current AMV/EBITDA discount of 52 percent," he said.
Jakab said that Egis was in the process of boosting its number of sales personnel to three times the former level both inside Hungary and abroad.
"We view this as a positive step," Jakab said.
